subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Why Patterns Feel Sacred
description: A short lesson to help you apply Why Patterns Feel Sacred.

hook.text: Humans see faces in clouds, animals in stars, and divine messages in numbers. We're pattern-finding machines.

buildup.text: Apophenia—seeing patterns where none exist—is a cognitive feature, not a bug. Survival depended on it.

discovery.text: Sacred numbers gain power through repetition. Once three is sacred in one context, we find it everywhere.

twist.text: The patterns may not be in the cosmos—they may be in us. The sacred emerges where math meets human need.

climax.text: Numbers and geometry feel sacred because our brains reward pattern recognition. Meaning is built in to perception.

punchline.text: The pattern is real. The meaning is ours.
